description_en: Queries the status of Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN), including the current billing method, service activation time, next effective billing method, and current service status
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnService查询DCDN服务状态。包括：当前计费类型、服务开通时间、下次生效的计费类型、当前业务状态等
name: DescribeDcdnService

ChangingAffectTime.description_en: The next effective period in GMT

ChangingChargeType.description_en:
The next effective billing method. Valid values:
PayByTraffic: traffic.
PayByBandwidth: bandwidth.
PayByBandwidth95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth.
PayByBandwidth_monthavg: monthly average bandwidth.
PayByBandwidth_month4th: monthly fourth peak bandwidth.
PayByBandwidth_monthday95avg: monthly average 95th percentile bandwidth.
PayByBandwidth_nighthalf95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth with a 50% discount during nighttime
ChangingChargeType.description_zh:
下次生效的计费类型。

PayByTraffic：流量。

PayByBandwidth：带宽。

PayByBandwidth95：月95。

PayByBandwidth_monthavg：月平均带宽。

PayByBandwidth_month4th：月第四峰值。

PayByBandwidth_monthday95avg：月平均95。

PayByBandwidth_nighthalf95：月95夜间减半

OpeningTime.description_en: The service activation time in the ISO 8601 format
OpeningTime.description_zh: 开通服务时间，ISO 8601时间格式

WebsocketChangingTime.description_en: The effective period of the WebSocket Upgrade/Downgrade, which is the same as the value of ChangingAffectTime. This value must be compared with the current time and is displayed on the frontend only if it is later than the current time. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
WebsocketChangingTime.description_zh:
与ChangingAffectTime值一样，Websocket变配生效时间，需要与当前时间比较，晚于当前时间才在前端显示。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

WebsocketChangingType.description_en:
The next effective billing method for WebSocket. Valid values:
websockettraffic: traffic.
websocketbps: bandwidth
WebsocketChangingType.description_zh: Websocket下次生效的计费类型，包括websockettraffic（流量）和websocketbps（带宽）
